summary: The accounts Nora keeps of people, groups and herself are cheaper to write and no longer carry a stale presence line into other rooms.
details: A room's pass no longer continues an account that cites nothing: those were written while the pass could read where people were, and are re-written from the room's own messages instead of being carried forward.
A person's pass reads only their newest 100 messages rather than 300, and has no web search or fetch.
Her own account in a group needs at least three responses to cite, and wakes only on responses that count as evidence.
Offline evals of a tag turn now carry the group's account and the listed people's accounts as of the moment, as production does.
limitations: A room whose account predates citations has no account carried forward until its next pass writes one.
